notes: Ask your school counselor how your district sends students here.
name: Wilson Talent Center career and technical programs
org: Ingham Intermediate School District, Wilson Talent Center
what_you_do: Take career classes as a junior or senior. You can choose car repair, welding, hair care, cooking or coding. You can also choose cyber safety, patient care, sports medicine or criminal justice.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors. The page does not say which districts are eligible or whether outside students can enroll.
deadline_text: The page says the application for Fall 2027 is open. No deadline is listed. First day for 2026-27 students was Aug 26, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now button on the program page (watch the tutorial video first). Phone 517-244-1330.
